name: Cheering soul
description: a damned soul of the Ember Wastes, stuck in Hell's loop forever: a thin hunched bald human figure in a long ragged ash-grey shroud, pale ash-grey skin, hollow tired eyes, a soft pale blue-white glow around its outline, bare feet, both thin arms raised overhead, a scrap of ash-grey cloth held like a flag, a weary hopeful smile

poses.stand: standing hunched, both thin arms raised overhead
poses.react: both arms up waving the scrap of cloth

idle.action: rocks gently in place, breathing slowly

react.action: waves the cloth flag side to side, tired but trying, then droops
